availability.note: MY27 (AUSOL2027) model page embeds variant 'Solterra AWD' with isActive true and a manufacturersListPrice; Build Your Own CTA links /configure/configure/AUSOL2027. CarExpert MY27 page: released to the Australian market 3 Oct 2026

listPrice.note: Subaru AU page data 'manufacturersListPrice':61990.00 for MY27 AUEW2EKBV (displayed price is postcode RDP drive-away; the MLP field is the list). Same figure in CarExpert 14 May 2026 price-cut table headed 'New price before on-road costs' (https://www.carexpert.com.au/car-news/subaru-cuts-ev-pricing-again-with-thousands-slashed-off-solterra-trailseeker), down $2,000. CarsGuide 2027 price page and CarExpert spec-page boilerplate still show the pre-cut 63990 - stale aggregator data; manufacturer preferred per owner convention

batteryKwh.note: usable: Toyota UK press pack for the same e-TNGA pack, '104 cells and a maximum gross capacity of 74.7kWh (71kWh net)'. Subaru AU specs: Li-ion, 104 cells, 391 V, 74.7 kWh unlabelled (gross per Subaru rule). EV Database ev-database.org/car/3401 also 74.7 nominal / 71.0 usable; EV Database has no 74.7 kWh Solterra page (Europe gets the 73.1/69.0 pack, car 3434)

rangeKm.note: Subaru AU specs '+Electric driving range (WLTP) (km)': 566, ADR 81/02, 18-inch 235/60 R18. Direction test: identical to toyota-bz4x-awd's 517 km on 20-inch (same drivetrain); below the bZ4X FWD 591 km and EV Database Touring AWD TEL 528 km, so not NEDC-inflated

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: 16.0 kWh/100km (twin toyota-bz4x-awd / Solterra Touring, 160 Wh/km WLTP on 20-inch) x 517/566 to scale to the 18-inch range; implied 71.0/566 = 12.5. CarExpert MY27 spec page's 181 Wh/km (same on both grades) rejected: 44% above battery/range and identical across a 49 km range gap, likely carried from the 2023 car

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: Subaru AU specs 'Cargo volume - rear seat up/down (litres)': 421; CarExpert MY27 spec page 'Rear seat up; to lower window: 421 L' (https://www.carexpert.com.au/subaru/solterra/2027-suv-4x4-electric-jsfwwa8k20261014). Cover convention. Held row had 410 on both grades

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: Marque News (22 Mar 2026): 'expanding to around 1050 litres with the rear seatbacks folded', not split by grade. Replaces held 2005 from the CarExpert review table, which matches Subaru's Touring tare weight (2005 kg; AWD 1980 kg, which CarExpert lists as the AWD 'folded' figure) and exceeds the US EPA to-roof 63.5 cu ft (1,798 L), so is a weight transcribed as volume. Cross-check: EPA ratio 63.5/23.8 x 421 = 1,123 L, same order. Subaru AU publishes no folded figure

towKg.note: With trailer brakes (max) 1500 kg; without 750 kg

warrantyYears.note: 5 Year/Unlimited Km warranty, unconditional. CarExpert: battery 8 years/160,000 km

insuranceAnnual.note: held; anchored with toyota-bz4x-2wd ($1,620 at $55,990) and subaru-uncharted-awd ($1,600 at $59,990) below and subaru-trailseeker-awd ($1,720 at $63,990) above; price unchanged since held

depreciationCurve.note: One Subaru curve (owner convention): [1, 0.74, 0.63, 0.55, 0.48, 0.42], the curve on every held Subaru row (Solterra, Trailseeker, Uncharted). Below mainstream default on documented evidence: two RRP cuts in six months (Nov 2025 -$6,000/-$7,000, May 2026 -$2,000) hitting earlier-stock residuals, thin local volume; sits just under the Toyota twin's 0.75 for Subaru's smaller network
